text:
Mira: Quick proposal — launch a compact benchmark-led post + three short webinars. Add a $10 credit voucher + two curated prompt packs in the onboarding. Goal: increase 1st->repeat usage within 7 days. :rocket:

Alex: Sounds solid. What's the core hypothesis?

Mira: H1: a compact cost/latency/quality snapshot will increase trust and prompt immediate template trials. H2: live webinars will lift retention for mid-funnel signups. We'll A/B both the headline and routing.

Zoe: Copy recs — ultra-scannable: 1) one-line claim, 2) tiny snapshot graphic (latency | cost | quality), 3) CTA to claim pack + credit. Keep CTAs low-friction so devs can click straight into the console.

Ravi: Measurement and events: landing.view, webinar.signup, pack.claim, gen.request, gen.repeat, billing.event. Tag cohorts with utm_experiment=quicklaunch and cohort label snap_vs_demo.

Jen (analytics): Leading metric = % of new signups that run >=2 generation requests within 7 days. Lagging = 14-day paid conversion. I'll assemble SQL and a dashboard. Need ~1.2k signups per arm for ~80% power given expected conversion rates.

Sam: Routing plan: utm=quicklaunch -> onboarding_flow_pack (pack-first); utm=webinar -> onboarding_flow_webinar (nurture-first); direct/no-utm -> neutral_flow. Set cookie to prevent re-routing on subsequent visits.

Mira: Pack-first flow = quick in-console preview + explicit "run sample" button for the first template, plus two follow-up nudges over 48 hours. Webinar flow = calendar + reminder, then pack follow-up email.

Alex: Microtest headlines: A) "Real numbers for real apps" B) "Ship faster with ready prompt packs". Split 70/30 to favour learnings but keep conversions stable. Monitor CTR -> signup -> pack.apply.

Ravi: Ops: demo runner protection — add rate limit 4rps/user for example runs and warm the KV cache for the demo templates. Also ensure demo runs don't count against a user's paid quota.

Zoe: I'll draft two hero lines, three CTA micro-variants, and a compact snapshot image. Deliverables by tomorrow 11:00 PT. :pencil2:

Jen (analytics): Quick rollout checklist:
- instrument events
- cohort tag on signups
- deploy AB headline variants
- configure routing (utm -> flow)
- enforce demo rate limits
- create retention dashboard (7d, 14d)

deploy-bot: Routing PR opened: #5482 (onboarding routing + utm parsing). CI checks passed. :robot_face:

webhook-bot: Preview deploy ready: https://deploys/internal/preview/5482

Mira: Love it. 15m sync tomorrow to finalise copy and confirm launch hour. Target launch: Tuesday 09:00 PT. Thanks all! :tada:
